class.name: DataValidation
class.brief_description: The issues found by a data validation, with their positions.

method.name: add_issue
method.description: Adds an issue, for checks of your own. Ignored when the result already holds [member DataValidationOptions.max_issues] issues.

method.name: get_invalid_rows
method.description: Returns the rows that have at least one issue, sorted, each once.

method.name: get_issue_column
method.description: Returns the 0-based CSV column of the issue at [param index], or [constant POSITION_NONE].

method.name: get_issue_field
method.description: Returns the name of the field (key, column or attribute) of the issue at [param index], or an empty [StringName].

method.name: get_issue_kind
method.description: Returns the kind of the issue at [param index].

method.name: get_issue_line
method.description: Returns the 1-based text line of the issue at [param index], or [constant POSITION_NONE]. Lines are set only with [member DataValidationOptions.keep_positions] or by [method resolve_lines].

method.name: get_issue_message
method.description: Returns the message of the issue at [param index], in English.

method.name: get_issue_path
method.description: Returns the path of the value of the issue at [param index]: keys and indices joined with [code]/[/code], such as [code]"enemies/3/hp"[/code]. For a missing field, the path of the entry that misses it. Empty for issues of the whole data or of a CSV header.

method.name: get_issue_row
method.description: Returns the 0-based row of the issue at [param index] (the entry of the root list, or the CSV data row without the header), or [constant POSITION_NONE].

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if there are no issues.

method.name: resolve_lines
method.description: Sets the line of every issue that has a path and no line by searching the keys of its path in [param text], in order; an index [code]n[/code] picks the [code](n + 1)[/code]-th following occurrence of the next key. Use it for [JSON] data validated with [method DataSchema.validate]. Best effort: exact for files with one key per line, approximate for keys on one line. Searches are shared between issues, so the cost stays close to one pass over [param text] even for many issues.

constants.constant: A [member DataField.required] key or column is missing.
A key or column is not in the schema (see [member DataSchema.extra_fields]).
A value does not have, or does not convert to, the type of its field.
A number is outside the range of [constant PROPERTY_HINT_RANGE].
A value is not one of [constant PROPERTY_HINT_ENUM].
A value does not match [member DataField.pattern].
A value is empty, but [member DataField.allow_empty] is [code]false[/code].
A value of a [member DataField.unique] field repeats.
The text could not be parsed (see [method TextDataFormat.get_error_message]).
A locale is not valid (used by translation checks).
Represents the size of the [enum IssueKind] enum.
The value of a position (row, column, line) that does not apply.
